title: Practice Tests
description: An array of practice tests, each a named collection of questions. Mirrors canadacitizenshipexam/Models/CCETest.swift and CCEQuestion.swift, and validates canadacitizenshipexam/data/tests/Base.lproj/tests.json. For now every question is assumed to be multiple choice (isMultipleChoice is fixed to true); other question types are out of scope until that changes.

id.description: Stable identifier. Not present in the current sample data — CCETest.id is filled in once a test is persisted (e.g. assigned by Firestore) — so it's optional here rather than required.

name.description: User-facing test name, e.g. "Rights and responsibilities".

timeOnTest.description: Expected time to complete the test, in seconds. Not present in the current sample data, so optional here — same reasoning as id.

totalSubmissions.description: How many times this test has been submitted by the community.

communityAverageScore.description: Community average score as a percentage, matching how scores are treated elsewhere in the app (see K.passingScoreInPercent).

answers.description: The multiple-choice options. Fixed at exactly 4 for now — matches every question in the current sample data, and CCEQuestion's own (currently self-contradicting) init, which derives isMultipleChoice from answers.count == 4 rather than trusting the value on disk.

correctAnswer.description: Must exactly match one entry in this question's own `answers` array. Plain JSON Schema can't express a same-object cross-field constraint like that, so it isn't enforced here — validate it separately (e.g. in a content-authoring script) when adding new questions.

isMultipleChoice.description: Always true for now — every question is assumed to be multiple choice. Revisit this schema when other question types are introduced.

explanation.description: Rationale shown after answering. May be an empty string — several sample questions have none yet.

stats.description: Community answer-selection counts, one bucket per answer slot (A-D, matching the 4 fixed answers above).
